subject: Intermittent generation failures from rw13-small — incident update & next steps
messages:
From: Samantha Lin <samantha.lin@edgewave.com>
To: support@redwood.com
Cc: ops@edgewave.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: High rate of generation failures from rw13-small for EdgeWave production

Hi team,

Since ~08:45 PT we are seeing elevated failures from the rw13-small model when generating longer responses (approx >350 tokens). Errors are returned as 5xx with a consistent failure mode: "generation stalled: token timeout". This is impacting our live summarization pipeline and causing retries that blow past our latency budget.

Sample request id: edge-req-20270405-1382
Sample error (truncated):
{
  "error": "5xx",
  "message": "generation stalled: token timeout after 12s"
}

We've attached a small set of request/response payloads and a compact log extract. Can you confirm whether this is a known regression and what the mitigation plan is? We are evaluating whether to failover traffic to another model; please advise.

Thanks,
Samantha Lin
SRE, EdgeWave Tech

Attachments: edgewave-sample-payloads.json (45 KB), request-log-snippet.txt (12 KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lin <samantha.lin@edgewave.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: High rate of generation failures from rw13-small for EdgeWave production

Hi Samantha — thanks for the quick report and the payloads. We're looking into this as a priority.

Immediate items:
- I've onboarded SRE (Hannah) and CS (Marcus) to coordinate with you.
- Engineering is triaging logs now to identify whether this is a model-serving regression, quantization kernel, or a routing/queueing issue.
- Can you confirm current traffic split (percent of requests hitting rw13-small) and whether you can accept a 10% traffic diversion to rw13-medium for 30 minutes for testing?

Temporary mitigation we can apply from our side (if agreed):
1) Route 10% of production requests to rw13-medium as a fallthrough model alias — no code change required on your end.
2) Enable a short request-level timeout at 10s on heavy-generation routes (we can coordinate to avoid double timeouts).
3) Share a priority RT ticket (TICKET-9421) — our SRE will push a kernel rollback if the telemetry points to a runtime regression.

I'll update you in 30–60 minutes with initial findings.

- Vivek
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment: rw13-small-ops-logs-2027-04-05.txt (logs uploaded to ticket)

From: Darren Holt <darren.holt@edgewave.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lin <samantha.lin@edgewave.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: High rate of generation failures from rw13-small for EdgeWave production

Vivek — we can do 10% diversion to rw13-medium immediately for the next hour to validate. Current split is ~100% to rw13-small in our production alias.

Please also note we have a scheduled batch of long summaries at 11:00 PT; is it possible to hold that window while you perform testing? We prefer the testing window before the batch starts.

Darren
Engineering Manager, EdgeWave

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Darren Holt <darren.holt@edgewave.com>, Samantha Lin <samantha.lin@edgewave.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: High rate of generation failures from rw13-small for EdgeWave production

Thanks Darren — we've scheduled the 10% diversion now and set the routing TTL to 30 mins. Initial telemetry: error rate on rw13-small at 09:00–09:20 PT spiked to ~6.1% of requests for >10s generation; after diversion we see a drop to 1.2% overall.

Preliminary root cause (engineering): a runtime kernel selection change deployed at 08:30 PT selected a quantization-friendly attention kernel for short sequences but introduced a pathological path for long sequences with a particular tokenization boundary. This led to token-level stalls under certain prefixes. We've rolled back the change in canary and are promoting the rollback to the rw13-small pool now.

Immediate actions taken:
- Rolled back kernel change in canary and started rollback to rw13-small pool (09:40 PT).
- Warmed KV cache for active EdgeWave prefixes.
- Enabled fallback routing to rw13-medium for 10% traffic during rollout.
- Opened postmortem doc and uploaded logs to the drive link.

Next steps:
1) Monitor 2 hours of post-rollback telemetry and validate error rates return to baseline (<0.5%).
2) Run targeted synthetic tests against the offending tokenization boundary and add a regression test to the build.
3) Prepare a short postmortem and remediation plan; we'll share an initial draft by EOD tomorrow.

I've attached concise ops logs and the ticket link. Will keep you posted.

— Hannah
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lin <samantha.lin@edgewave.com>, Darren Holt <darren.holt@edgewave.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Intermittent generation failures from rw13-small — incident update & next steps

Hi Samantha / Darren — final update from our side and draft postmortem attached. Summary:

What happened:
- A kernel selection change deployed 2027-04-05T08:30 PT incorrectly prioritized a quantization attention kernel for short sequences. For requests that crossed a tokenization boundary around ~350 tokens the chosen code path could enter a long-tail stall, causing the generation to exceed our request-level timeout and surface as 5xx "generation stalled".

Impact:
- EdgeWave: ~6% of long-generation requests failed during the 08:30–09:40 PT window. No data exfiltration or integrity issues detected; only availability impact to long responses.
- Internal: SRE rollback and routing changes resulted in transient increased load on rw13-medium for 10% of traffic during the test window.

Remediation taken:
- Immediate rollback of the kernel change at 09:40 PT (reverted in production pool by 10:05 PT).
- Warmed KV cache and rebalanced serving allocation to absorb transient reroute traffic.
- Added regression tests that emulate the tokenization boundary case.
- Engineering will ship an automated gate to prevent that kernel from being selected for sequences >300 tokens.

Follow-ups and customer offer:
- We will run a joint verification sweep with EdgeWave traffic for 48 hours and provide daily telemetry snapshots.
- As a gesture of goodwill, Redwood will apply a 10% service credit for the impacted usage window.
- We are happy to produce a signed postmortem; attached is the current draft (rw13-small-postmortem-draft-2027-04-07.pdf).

Please let us know if you want a live review of the postmortem with product and engineering — happy to schedule. Thanks again for the quick coordination.

Best,
Vivek
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rw13-small-postmortem-draft-2027-04-07.pdf (2 pages), rw13-small-ops-logs-2027-04-05.txt (logs)
